name: DanCo Services

hero.title: Concrete work
hero.lead: DanCo Services handles commercial concrete repair, asphalt paving, striping & ADA compliance for Houston property managers, HOAs & GCs. Get a quote.

summary: DanCo Services offers concrete paving and panel replacement, sidewalk, curb, and trip hazard repair, and full-depth concrete repair across New Caney, Baytown and Houston.

groups.title: Concrete Paving and Panel Replacement
groups.summary: Not every concrete problem can be patched.
groups.intro: Not every concrete problem can be patched. Damaged panels, cracked sections, settled areas, broken edges, and surface failures often need full panel replacement to hold up under commercial traffic long-term. DanCo evaluates each damaged section individually — repairing where patching will last, and replacing panels where it won’t.

groups.title: Sidewalk, Curb, and Trip Hazard Repair
groups.summary: Uneven sidewalks, damaged curbs, and trip hazards are a liability risk on any commercial property.
groups.intro: Uneven sidewalks, damaged curbs, and trip hazards are a liability risk on any commercial property. DanCo repairs and replaces sidewalks, curbs, and pedestrian paths, correcting uneven panel transitions and settled sections along walkways, entrances, and parking areas.

groups.title: Full-Depth Concrete Repair
groups.summary: When a section of concrete has failed below the surface, DanCo performs full-depth repair: sawcutting and demoing the damaged section, hauling off debris, reviewing the subgrade and base, adding doweling or rebar reinforcement where needed, forming, placing and finishing new concrete, and curing it properly before the site is cleaned up and reopened.

groups.title: Concrete Repair for Commercial Properties
groups.summary: Every property has different traffic patterns, drainage conditions, and tenant considerations, so we scope repairs around how the site is actually used rather than a one-size-fits-all spec.

groups.title: Asphalt Overlay and Resurfacing
groups.summary: An asphalt overlay adds a new layer of asphalt over an existing surface and is often the most cost-effective option when the base underneath is still structurally sound but the surface has aged, cracked, or worn down.

about.title: About DanCo Services
text: DanCo Services is a locally owned and operated company based in Houston, proudly serving commercial properties, HOAs, retail centers, and industrial facilities throughout the Greater Houston area. We understand the unique demands of Houston’s climate, soil conditions, and high-traffic commercial environments, allowing us to deliver durable concrete, asphalt, and parking lot solutions built to last.

At DanCo, quality workmanship goes hand in hand with clear, consistent communication. From the initial estimate to project completion, clients receive transparent timelines, regular updates, and a dedicated point of contact. Our commercial-grade standards ensure long-lasting results while minimizing future maintenance, downtime, and unexpected costs.

Your property and people are protected at every stage of the project. DanCo Services is fully insured and follows strict industry safety standards to safeguard employees, customers, and tenants. Our experienced crews work efficiently while maintaining secure, well-managed job sites that reduce risk, liability, and operational disruptions.
